data.one_liner: An HTTP client generator for Dart and Flutter using source_gen.
data.what_it_does: Chopper is an HTTP client generator inspired by Retrofit. It allows developers to define API services using annotations and generates the boilerplate implementation code using source_gen and build_runner.
use_when: You want a Retrofit-style declarative HTTP client for REST or HTTP QUERY APIs in Dart or Flutter
You want code generation to handle request boilerplate and typing
avoid_when: You prefer an imperative HTTP client without code generation steps
You do not want to run build_runner in your development workflow
strengths: Built-in support for request converters and interceptors
weaknesses: Additional build step can slow down development cycles
data.setup_notes: Add chopper to dependencies, and build_runner and chopper_generator to dev_dependencies. Run build_runner to generate code.
